en.headline: Special traffic plans set for Mid-Autumn and fire dragon nights
en.dek: The Transport Department said road closures and extra public transport will run from 24 to 26 September, including overnight MTR on festival night.
body: The Transport Department said special traffic and public transport arrangements will be in force from 24 to 26 September to support Mid-Autumn Festival events, including the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance.

Road closures and diversions will be imposed around Tai Hang across those three days. Further closures and diversions will apply on 25 and 26 September in parts of Hong Kong Island, including Causeway Bay, the Peak, Aberdeen, Pok Fu Lam, Repulse Bay and Shek O, and in Tuen Mun, Tsuen Wan and Ma On Shan. Some parking spaces, taxi stands and public light bus stands in those areas will be suspended.

On Mid-Autumn night on 25 September, most MTR lines will strengthen service from 3pm and run into the early hours of 26 September. The Airport Express, Disneyland Resort Line and the East Rail Line section to Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau are excluded. Eleven Light Rail routes and three MTR bus routes will also run later, and tram, bus, green minibus and ferry operators will add or extend services. Four special bus routes will operate, and dozens of bus and minibus routes will be diverted.
The department advised people to use public transport and to check HKeMobility and operator notices, saying police may adjust arrangements according to crowd and traffic conditions.

zh.headline: 中秋及大坑舞火龍期間實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署公布9月24至26日將有封路及加強公共交通服務，中秋夜大部分港鐵絲會通宵行駛。
body: 運輸署表示，為配合中秋節活動及大坑舞火龍，9月24日至26日將實施特別交通及公共交通安排。
大坑一帶這三天會封路及改道。9月25及26日，港島銅鑼灣、山頂、香港仔、薄扶林、淺水灣及石澳，以及新界屯門、荃灣及馬鞍山部分路段亦會封路或改道，上述地區部分停車位、的士站及小巴站將暫停。
中秋正日9月25日，大部分港鐵絲由下午3時起加密班次，並延長服務至26日凌晨，機場快絲、迪士尼絲及東鐵絲羅湖、落馬洲段除外。11條輕鐵絲及3條港鐵巴士絲亦會延長服務，電車、巴士、專線小巴及渡輪會按需求加強或延長服務。當日將開辦4條特別巴士絲，另有數十條巴士及小巴絲因封路改道。
運輸署呼籲市民盡量乘搭公共交通，並留意「香港出行易」及各營辦商通告。警方會視乎人流及交通情況調整安排。
